data.title: Damac Chic Tower
data.about:
Chic Tower, influenced by turquoise’s healing properties, is a location where wellness and opulence coexist. De Grisogono, a master jeweler, designed these apartments. The opulent residences include studios, and one, two, three, and four-bedroom apartments.

 Chic Tower is of unparalleled quality and was created with your comfort in mind. You can also enjoy the magnificent view of Dubai’s iconic Canal from your home, giving you a new perspective on life.

Chic Tower combines opulence and wellness in the heart of Dubai. De Grisigono’s interpretation of one of the world’s most beloved gemstones includes restorative baths, beauty treatments, cutting-edge gyms, residential luxury, and the fabled fountain of youth.

location_tile.title: Located in Business Bay
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description: The chic Business Bay tower is a waterfront address near Downtown, Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and Dubai International Financial Centre. If your journey takes you outside of the city limits, Dubai International Airport is only a 15-minute drive away.
